summary: Divides polygon surfaces into smoother Catmull-Clark subdivision surfaces with crease, crack-closing, and output-crease controls.
common_gotchas: Creases match by point numbers, not proximity.
overridecrease and crease attribute defaults change how existing creases are interpreted.
bias applies only when pulling cracks closed.
No-edge-division disables bias when pulling cracks.
High iteration counts multiply geometry quickly.
key_concepts: Subdivide SOP applies Catmull-Clark smoothing to polygon surfaces.
Best results require convex, relatively even polygon distribution.
Creases can come from a second input or crease attributes; shared-edge crease weight uses the maximum value.
Crack closing can pull or stitch surrounding faces, with different edge behavior.
